title: Houston answers a question his mother asked only in her head

tellings.quote: question in my head without speaking and he answered the question that I had asked him in my head

plain: A mother named Katie, from Atlanta, Georgia, says she asked her son Houston a question silently, only in her head, and he answered it. She tells it as something she saw herself, on an episode about children said to be able to read minds, and if true it would mean he picked up her thought without any words.
